mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CLASS ( CLASS_IDX, PROVIDER_IDX, TITLE, INTRO, MINOR_FIELD_IDX, MINOR_REGION_IDX, PRICE, START_DATE, END_DATE, CREATED_AT, MAX_USER_CNT ) VALUES ( SEQ_CLASS.NEXTVAL, #{providerIdx}, #{title}, #{intro}, #{minorFieldIdx}, #{minorRegionIdx}, #{price}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, SYSDATE, #{maxUserCnt} )
mapper.select: SELECT MAJOR_FIELD_IDX, MAJOR_FIELD_CD FROM MAJOR_FIELD ORDER BY MAJOR_FIELD_IDX
SELECT MINOR_FIELD_IDX, MINOR_FIELD_NM FROM MINOR_FIELD WHERE MAJOR_FIELD_IDX = #{majorFieldIdx} ORDER BY MINOR_FIELD_NM
SELECT MAJOR_REGION_IDX, REGION_NM FROM MAJOR_REGION ORDER BY MAJOR_REGION_IDX
